name: cliq
description: Cliq 2.0: Expo app and API. Run `npm install` once, then `npm start`.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix apps/server install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names api,app --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm --prefix apps/server run dev" "npm --prefix apps/mobile start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/server test && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck
